The vault implementation is copied unchanged from [Papan src/vault.js at c01beea](https://github.com/chelij/papan/blob/c01beea/src/vault.js), renamed to `.mjs` for standalone Node.js imports. It generates native Papan files for compatibility tests; it is not part of the extension or release ZIP. The small portrait.mp4 is Papan's synthetic media test fixture. Both are covered by this repository's GPL-3.0-or-later license.
